# Certified Handmade

> Hand-Drawing Artist Local DRM & Cryptographic Provenance Toolkit
> 手描きアーティストのための完全ローカル・スタンドアローン暗号署名＆手描きDRMツール
> "Your artwork should outlive the platform that certifies it." / 「あなたの作品は、それを証明するプラットフォームより長く生き続けるべきだ。」

## Overview
Certified Handmade (https://certified-handmade.com/) is a 100% local, standalone, open-source (MIT) progressive web application (PWA) for hand-drawing artists, illustrators, and creators. It creates and verifies self-contained cryptographic provenance certificates (Ed25519 + SHA-256 + RFC 8949 CBOR) and embeds scannable verification QR codes inside lossless PNG artwork — with zero backend server, zero accounts, zero tracking, and full offline functionality.

## Core Architecture & Cryptography
- **Local-First & Standalone PWA**: Runs entirely client-side inside the browser with `connect-src 'self'` CSP enforcement. Works completely offline after initial load via Service Worker precaching.
- **Cryptographic Signing (`Ed25519` + `SHA-256`)**: Computes canonical RGBA8 pixel digests (`SHA-256`) bound to artist identity keys (`Ed25519`) and explicit copyright/license metadata (`ARR`, `CC BY 4.0`, `CC BY-NC 4.0`, `CC BY-ND 4.0`, `CC BY-NC-ND 4.0`, `CC BY-SA 4.0`, `CC0 1.0`, `Custom`), serialized as deterministic RFC 8949 CBOR inside URL `#proof=` fragments and PNG `tEXt` metadata (`chm-proof-v2`).
- **Encrypted Key Management (`AES-256-GCM` + `PBKDF2-SHA256`)**: Artist signing keys are generated locally and exportable as passphrase-encrypted `.chkey.json` backups encrypted with AES-256-GCM (310,000 PBKDF2-SHA256 iterations).
- **Offline Public-Key Exchange (`@yomiplush/chm-exchange`)**: Shares and inspects public-only Ed25519 artist keys via `#key=` URLs, QR PNGs, and JSON bundles (`/exchange`) with locally recomputed SHA-256 fingerprints and explicit manual trust confirmation.
- **Manual In-Image QR Studio & Outer Frame Modes**: Burn cryptographic proof QR codes cleanly into an outer border frame (`/create`) or manually place a semi-transparent / corner-masked QR inside the PNG canvas (`/create?mode=studio`) with masked pixel integrity verification (`in-image-masked`).
- **3-Axis Honest Verification (`/verify`)**: Independently reports A. Cryptographic Signature (`Valid`/`Invalid`), B. Artwork Pixel Integrity (`Matched`/`Mismatched`/`Not Checked`), and C. Author Key Trust (`Locally Trusted Key`/`Unknown`) offline without overclaiming automated "human-made" proof.

## Key Routes
- `/` — Overview, manifesto, 3-step guide, core local-first principles, and FAQ
- `/create` — Sign artwork, embed outer QR or switch to Manual In-Image QR Studio (`/create?mode=studio`)
- `/verify` — Offline verification via signed PNG upload, QR camera scan, clipboard paste, PWA Web Share Target (`/share-target`), or `#proof=` URL fragment
- `/tutorial` — Beginner step-by-step guide and license cheat sheet
- `/keys` — Local Ed25519 key generation, public key sharing, and AES-256-GCM encrypted backup/restore
- `/exchange` — Standalone offline public-key exchange UI powered by `@yomiplush/chm-exchange` (`/exchange#key=...`)
- `/docs` — Cryptographic architecture, license guide, protocol reference, and open-source specification (`SPEC.md`)
- `/privacypolicy` — GDPR-compliant privacy notice (zero tracking, consent-gated UI language preference)
